title: Concept: Dependency declared with an either-or range
description: package.json declares an `||` range that lets two different major lines satisfy one declaration, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installing machine, not the manifest, decides which line runs, so two builds of the same commit can compile different code.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The installing machine, not the manifest, decides which line runs, so two builds of the same commit can compile different code.
